_comment: ice_tower: Map 4's guard tower, map 1's tower in ice. A fused, fluted, faceted ice column (three merged stalagmite lobes at the foot, refrozen bulges, flow ribs under the piers) from 0.4 m below the pit floor (z -36.8) to a frozen ledge under the sill; the drum on map 1's datum (floor 1.70, r 6.86 / ~7.78, eight round-headed 40 deg openings at 25 + 45k, sill 2.35, crown 7.00, ceiling 7.25); an ice cornice with drips (tips >= 6.85 over openings, long ones in front of the piers) and a low faceted dome with a snow cap to z 10.22. One closed contiguous art mesh IceTower, COLOR_0 over ice_blue (cyl and box), ice_deep, ice_snow; IceTowerCollision-colonly purpose-built.
